The brand

Celebrate the beauty of the game

Golf culture, not golf uniform.

Richmans Sport makes golf hats and golf wall art for the new wave of players: the ones who get to the course in a cart full of friends, post the round, and wear the hat to dinner after. The designs lean into golf's own language (tee times, upside-down lettering, eagles, Augusta greens) and give it a streetwear edge.

The brand grew online and through golf creators first. That demand is what we're bringing into stores.

  • Proven demandBuilt direct-to-consumer, with customers regularly buying 2 and 3 hats at a time.
  • Real reachWorn by LeBron James and a roster of golf creators, all organic.
  • Men's & women'sThe same styles sell to both. See the "Chosen by the best" wall.
  • Easy to stockSnapback, one size fits most, so there are no size runs or broken assortments.
  • A story for the wallThe golf art line gives the fixture a gallery look that no other hat brand brings.
